title: feat(plugin-form): section navigation for stacked sectioned forms
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9h1xhDQ7T3debR2uGogBa2)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgTZ8JB6JZFffVhT7R

Fixes #34605
Clause-②: yes (widening — one @object-ui/components export + new @object-ui/i18n locale keys; no FormSchema or spec key)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:分组(stacked)表单在对话框里,标题和滚动区之间多了一条分组导航;整页表单在分组上方显示同一条导航(吸顶)。点分组名滚到该分组,折叠的分组先展开;滚动时高亮当前分组;提交被拒后,有错误或必填未填的分组显示数量,填好后数量消失。
- 为什么改:长的分组表单(如 HotCRM 商机,四五个分组)提交失败时用户不知道错在哪一组,只能来回滚动找;导航让分组可直达、错误可定位。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `@object-ui/components`(表单渲染器上报分组列表、分组标题行加稳定 id)和 `@object-ui/plugin-form`(导航组件,接入 ModalForm / ObjectForm),外加两个 i18n 键;不动元数据、契约和服务端,也没有作者配置。只有 2 个及以上可见分组才显示;tab 布局与向导不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/FormSectionNav.tsx`(导航、滚动高亮、点击跳转);② `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` 中 `sectionNavItems` 与 `SectionNavReporter`(哪些分组上报、错误怎么按分组计数);③ `ModalForm.tsx` 与 `ObjectForm.tsx` 的接入点。
- 两分钟验证:在仓根执行 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/FormSectionNav.test.tsx packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-section-nav-34605.test.tsx`,预期 14 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。注意:Studio 表单视图的「预览」现在也会显示这条导航(预览复用运行时对话框,这是有意的镜像)。

## What changes

`@object-ui/components` (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/`):

- New `section-nav-context.ts`: `FormSectionNavContext` (a sink, `null` by default) and the `FormSectionNavItem` / `FormSectionNavSink` types, exported from the package index beside `SuggestedFieldsContext`.
- `form.tsx`: each drawn section heading row (`section-divider`) now carries a stable `id` (scoped to the form instance) and `data-form-section="<divider name>"`, with `scroll-mt-2`. When a sink is provided, the renderer reports the headings it actually draws in the stacked layout: key, label, anchor id, collapsed state, an `expand()` that goes through the row's own toggle, and the count of fields in that section holding a react-hook-form error. Membership reads each divider's `fields` claim, falling back to position as `splitAtUntitledRuns` does; a headingless run counts for no entry. A heading its `visibleWhen` hides is not drawn, so not reported. A tabbed form reports nothing. The renderer provides `null` to its own descendants, so a nested form never reports into the host's sink. Unmounting reports `null`. No sink: nothing changes, and `formState.errors` is not subscribed.

`@object-ui/plugin-form`:

- New `FormSectionNav.tsx`: `useFormSectionNav()` (a sink plus the reported items) and `<FormSectionNav items>`, which renders nothing below two items. Otherwise a `<nav aria-label="Form sections">` strip of buttons; the current entry carries `aria-current="true"`, an entry with errors carries `data-error` and `· N` (with screen-reader text "Fields to fix: N"). Click: expand if collapsed, then `scrollIntoView` the heading row on the next frame; the clicked entry turns current and the scroll spy is held off briefly so it does not flicker through the sections in between. Scroll spy: the nearest scrolling ancestor, rAF-throttled; at the bottom the last entry is current. In a narrow dialog the strip scrolls horizontally and keeps the current entry in view.
- `ModalForm.tsx`: the plain (non-subform) dialog provides the sink and draws the strip between `DialogHeader` and the scrolling body (the header drops its bottom border while the strip is drawn). `ObjectForm.tsx` (sectioned simple form): the strip sits above the form, `sticky top-0`.

`@object-ui/i18n`: `form.sectionNav` and `form.sectionNavErrors` in all 11 locales.

No FormSchema, view or spec key; nothing is configured.

## Why

The card: a long sectioned form refuses a submit and the user cannot tell which section holds the problem. The navigation makes each section one click away and marks the sections that need fixing.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1–3 are pinned in `FormSectionNav.test.tsx` (four entries under the dialog title, the third scrolls to the third section's heading row; an empty required field in section two shows `1` after submit; one section draws no strip), and read in a browser (below).
- **Footer missing-required hint: not implemented.** Triage comment 6937255202 says the card "carries the footer hint for missing required fields", but the card's acceptance does not include it; the seat agreed to leave it out. It can be a follow-up card.
- The Studio form-view **Preview** renders the runtime dialog, so it now shows the strip too. Intended: the preview mirrors the runtime form.
- Six existing tests read a section name with an unscoped `getByText`, which now finds two matches (the strip repeats the names). Each is scoped to the form (`within(form)`), test-only; one of them is in `@object-ui/app-shell` (`DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057.test.tsx`), widened by the seat.
- Out of scope per the card: the tabbed and wizard layouts.

## Verification

Readings against head `3e9036363c` (base `8dd8192c`, merged forward with `origin/main` at `31096af8`).

<details><summary>Before / after (browser)</summary>

A throwaway probe page served by the console's Vite dev server (not committed) mounting `ModalForm` and `ObjectForm` with an in-memory data source: a five-section create dialog "New Deal" (Overview / Forecast / Qualification / Description / Sales Strategy, the last collapsed; `forecast` required). Chromium 1280×800, driven with Playwright.

- Before: not measured in a browser. At base `8dd8192c` no section strip exists in the code; the dialog header sits directly over the scrolling body, and a refused submit marks the field only inside its section.
- After:
  - Five entries under the title; Overview current.
  - Click Qualification (third) → its heading row lands 8px below the scroller top, Qualification current.
  - Scrolling by hand: the highlight follows Overview → Forecast → …, and the last entry is current at the bottom.
  - Click the collapsed Sales Strategy → it unfolds (0 → 4 fields) and is scrolled to.
  - Submit with `forecast` empty → the Forecast entry shows `· 1`; filling the field clears it.
  - At 375px width: no page overflow; the strip scrolls sideways and keeps the current entry in view.
  - Full-page sectioned form: the strip stays at the top while the page scrolls.

</details>

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

Run from the repository root with `ui/` as vitest root, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/ packages/components/src/renderers/form/ packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057.test.tsx` → `Test Files  424 passed (424)`, `Tests  5113 passed | 31 skipped (5144)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- New: `packages/plugin-form/src/FormSectionNav.test.tsx` (7: acceptance 1–3, `visibleWhen`, collapsed unfold, tabbed none, ObjectForm) and `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-section-nav-34605.test.tsx` (7: report order and DOM ids, predicate-admitted heading, per-section error counts with a headingless run, collapsed + expand, tabbed none, nested form kept out, unmount → null).
- Type-check: `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/i18n` → lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- eslint on the touched files → 0 errors.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

Through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with an empty `git diff HEAD`:

1. Dropping the drawn-node check (`nodes[j] != null`), so hidden headings are reported → 2 tests red.
2. Dropping the error count → 2 tests red.
3. Providing the sink (not `null`) to the renderer's descendants → the nested-form test red.

</details>
